# Proposal Template

**Document ID:** TEMPLATE-PROPOSAL

**Schema version:** 1

**Kind:** roadmap/status

**Lifecycle:** current

**Subject:** template for one concise unpromoted proposal

**Surface:** template

**Boundary:** global

**Authority role:** non-normative

**Mutation:** authored

**Indexing:** exclude

Create one file per idea under `docs/proposals/` and add it to the proposal
index. A proposal is not a specification, commitment, or scheduler entry. Keep
it concise and link deeper evidence instead of copying it.

```text
# <Proposal title>

<extended document metadata using Surface proposal and Authority role non-normative>

## <BOUNDARY>-PROPOSAL-001

**State:** idea
**Idea:**
**Rationale:**
**Constraints:**
**Promotion target:** owner decision required

**Source:** optional link to evidence or an archive record
```
